suppress.notes: ActiveMQ Spring integration is still pinned to Spring Framework 5.3.39 in this build.
Hawtio console vulns; we aren't affected. Jolokia CSRF

This project is not affected as it't not using the vulnerable classes. https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/issues/24434#issuecomment-744519525. files: spring-aop-5.3.20.jar, spring-beans-5.3.20.jar, spring-context-5.3.20.jar, spring-core-5.3.20.jar, spring-expression-5.3.20.jar, spring-jcl-5.3.20.jar
5.3.39 is the latest version. To remediate this, a major version update would be needed, ie, Spring 6.x.x

file name: spring-boot-loader-2.7.18.jar We are pinned to Spring Boot 2.7.x on Java 17. There is no newer 2.7.x release in Maven Central, so these CVEs cannot be remediated by an in-line version bump at the moment.
Jetty 10.0.26 is the newest Jetty 10 release available in Maven Central. Remediation for this CVE requires moving off the Jetty 10 line, which is outside the current Java 17 / Jetty 10 constraints.

Spring Framework 5.3.39 is the final 5.3.x release (EOL). Upgrading to Spring 6.x requires significant breaking changes and is outside scope for a 5.0.7 patch release. These CVEs affect spring-aop, spring-beans, spring-context, spring-core, spring-expression and spring-jcl.
ActiveMQ 5.19.6 is the current pinned version. No newer 5.19.x release is available in Maven Central that resolves these CVEs. Review when a patched release becomes available.
proton-j 0.34.1 is the version pulled in by activemq-amqp. No newer release available that resolves these CVEs without bumping the ActiveMQ AMQP module. Review when a fixed release appears.
